_README: Q115: reconversion of ONLY 2 labels (11, 15) out of vhf_xfer_lowerlimb_septa.nii.gz's
57-label full set, at --smooth 0.0 instead of xfer_vhm2vhf_sep's own 1.0. Raw source main_frac
for these 2 labels measured 0.997-1.000 (1-5 small satellite components) but the shipped
bundle showed 0.669/0.825 -- smoothing was the destroyer. Label 12
(extensor_hallucis_longus_r) was investigated too and DECLINED -- measured directly, its
pre-decimation mesh is 0.55-0.56 main_frac at EITHER smoothing value (a marching-cubes surface
defect, not a smoothing/decimation artifact, the same failure class Q114 found for
geniohyoid_l/hyoglossus_r) -- so it is deliberately left OUT of this mapping and continues to
come from xfer_vhm2vhf_sep unchanged. Carries only these 2 labels so it can be listed before
xfer_vhm2vhf_sep in export_viewer_bundle.py's --subject order and claim just these 2
atlas_ids, leaving the other 55 muscles in vhf_xfer_lowerlimb_septa.nii.gz (and their own
smooth=1.0 conversion) completely untouched.
Q116: added 2 more labels from the same subject, same method (measured the pre-decimation
mesh's own main_frac at smooth=0 vs smooth=1 directly, then the ACTUAL post-decimation result
on the real generated mesh, not assumed from the raw-voxel gap alone): label 30 (plantaris_l,
raw voxel main_frac 1.000, pre-decimation mesh 0.998 at smooth=0 vs 0.916 at smooth=1, shipped
decimated bundle 0.918->0.997); label 9 (extensor_digitorum_longus_l, raw voxel 0.832,
pre-decimation mesh 0.749 at smooth=0 vs 0.533 at smooth=1, shipped decimated bundle
0.545->0.739 -- a real, sub-ceiling gain). Label 10 (extensor_digitorum_longus_r) was tested
the same way and DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: its pre-decimation mesh at smooth=0 also improves
(0.776 vs 0.408), but the ACTUAL post-decimation (clustering) result at smooth=0 measured WORSE
than its current smooth=1.0 shipped value (0.493 vs 0.661) -- a case where smoothing helps the
pre-decimation mesh but vertex-clustering's grid lands on a worse cell alignment afterward;
quadric decimation was also tried on it (both smoothing values) and was worse still (0.42-0.50).
Left unchanged on xfer_vhm2vhf_sep (smooth=1.0, shipped 0.661, its best measured value). Label
37 (rectus_femoris_r) was also probed and NOT added here: its own gain came from decimation
method (quadric, at its CURRENT smooth=1.0, no reconversion needed) -- see SHEET_IDS in
export_viewer_bundle.py instead. Labels 42/56/41/48/8 (semitendinosus_l, vastus_medialis_l,
semimembranosus_r, tibialis_anterior_l, biceps_femoris_r) showed no lever on either axis and
are left on xfer_vhm2vhf_sep unchanged, declined in the Q116 queue entry.
subject: ct_vhf_xfersepta_fix
